instruction: Rename Sheet1 to "Main", rename Sheet2 to "Secondary", and rename Sheet3 to "Archive".

metadata.explanation: Task requires renaming all three sheets. Evaluator checks that sheets at positions 0, 1, 2 have the expected names.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical data flow issue: evaluator.func points to metric check_xlsx_multi_rename__8cd3fd85, but vm_file result passes file path string, not sheet names list
Metric expects result parameter to be list of sheet names, but will receive file path string from vm_file getter
Missing getter invocation: the created getter get_xlsx_all_sheets__8cd3fd85 is not referenced in evaluator config
Static validation warning confirmed: metric does not consume vm_file result (no path operations on first arg)
Evaluator will fail at runtime: metric will receive wrong data type and return 0.0 instead of verifying renames
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change evaluator.func to reference the getter: "func": "get_xlsx_all_sheets__8cd3fd85"
Add evaluator.metric field to specify the metric: "metric": "check_xlsx_multi_rename__8cd3fd85"
Alternatively, restructure to use composite evaluator that chains getter->metric
The individual function logic is correct (getter extracts sheets, metric checks positions), only the wiring is broken
